title: Machine learning prioritises ACACA among R-loop genes in clear cell renal cell carcinoma
summary: Linear machine-learning prognostic models over 44 R-loop-related genes in public ccRCC cohorts prioritised ACACA, whose R-loop activity was higher in advanced disease and linked with poorer outcomes. In vitro and xenograft experiments showed that ACACA promoted proliferation and migration and suppressed apoptosis, with reduced R-loop accumulation and enhanced fatty-acid metabolism. Machine learning is one of several lines of evidence and wet-lab sample sizes were not read.
ai_technology: Elastic net (best of several linear machine-learning algorithms) prognostic modelling

evidence.tested: Pooled hazard ratio above 1 across public cohorts plus in vitro and xenograft experiments.
evidence.unknown: Wet-lab sample sizes; patient-level clinical use.
evidence.ai_role: Elastic net models ranked ACACA as the dominant R-loop-related gene.
